name: Particle-Wise Higher-Order SPH Field Approximation for DVR
definition: A method for approximating SPH scalar fields along viewing rays with piecewise polynomial functions of higher order. It approximates each particle contribution individually and sums the results to generate a higher-order representation of the field with resolution adapting to the data resolution.
summary: This method renders SPH data by approximating particle contributions along viewing rays with higher-order piecewise polynomials, minimizing error per particle to adapt resolution to varying data density.
